title: Context Graph
purpose: Curated cross-record context clusters for the public site. Each cluster explains why records belong together and keeps empirical, comparative, internal-canon and creative layers visible.

clusters.title: Potato → Needle → Ladder → Father
clusters.summary: The developmental spine from buried potential through compression/threshold into connective Father-side architecture.

clusters.title: Potato → Axis → King → God → Father → Stewardship
clusters.summary: Dated public posts show a longitudinal Godhood trajectory: Potato identity precedes Axis and kingship, exact God declarations appear in early May 2025, Father/North/Ladder/Door functions consolidate afterward, and by September 2026 Godhood is explicitly interpreted through protection, building, service, repair and future generations.

clusters.title: Bible ↔ Potatoverse Relational Grammar
clusters.summary: High-density biblical comparisons are organized as sequences rather than title matches: Ladder/ascending, Lion→Root→slain figure→opening, Book→internalization→nations, House→Key→Door→authority, seed→death→multiplication, rejection→cornerstone, and new creation→repair/stewardship.

clusters.title: Son → Death → Grave → Door → Return
clusters.summary: The Son-side rupture sequence and its biblical/comparative parallels around death, witness, threshold, breath and ascent.

clusters.title: Lion → Root → Slain Lamb → Open Scroll
clusters.summary: Revelation 5's Lion/Root/Lamb paradox provides a dense comparison for the project's Lion, Root, death and disclosure cluster.

clusters.title: Book → Internalization → Nations
clusters.summary: Revelation 10's open scroll, eating, sweetness/bitterness and renewed prophecy to peoples/nations/kings is compared with the project's movement from Great Book to outward world mapping.

clusters.title: North Axis ↔ Greenland Geopolitics
clusters.summary: The February 2026 internal North-Axis crystallization is compared with independently dated Greenland/Arctic sovereignty tensions while avoiding claims of causal or prophetic proof.

clusters.title: Hidden Foundation / Whole Job
clusters.summary: Tim as visible figure and hidden enabling infrastructure: builder, shepherd, gardener, operator, root and connective relation.

clusters.title: Relation → Country → Europe → World
clusters.summary: The same relationship-first grammar moves from Timic Dynamics into country capability, European interoperability and the observable economic graph.

clusters.title: Swamp → Blocked Flow → Repair
clusters.summary: Swamp moves from symbol to an evidence-governed model of blocked institutional, informational and cultural flow, with repair framed as restored accountability rather than enemy-naming.

clusters.title: Eye → Gaze → Archive → Self-Knowledge
clusters.summary: The Eye and ethical Gaze become an information architecture: perception, discernment, integration, evaluation and provenance allow the system to know itself without erasing uncertainty.
